en.linux.prefs.hideSystemIndicators: Hide GNOME’s Wi-Fi, volume and battery icons
en.linux.prefs.controlCenterGlyph: Show the Control Center icon for Quick Settings
en.linux.prefs.port: GNOME Shell port of the macOS app by lingyired.
en.linux.prefs.iconSize.description: Adjusts the rendered size of the top bar icon, from 16 to 36 pt.
en.linux.prefs.statusColors.description: Green while on power, yellow in power saver, red when low. Turn off to keep the ring in the label colour.
en.linux.prefs.chargingEffect.description: Plays the charging animation in the top bar icon. Stops when animations are turned off in GNOME.
en.linux.prefs.bluetoothIconColor.descripti: Colour of the Bluetooth device glyph in the middle: blue, or follow the top bar text colour.
en.linux.prefs.networkWarnings.description: When the computer is really offline, the middle shows the network state instead of the chosen source.
en.linux.prefs.volumeScroll.description: Scroll on the top bar icon or inside the status panel to change the output volume.
en.linux.prefs.hideSystemIndicators.descrip: Status Trio already shows Wi‑Fi, volume and battery, so the top bar stays uncluttered.
en.linux.prefs.controlCenterGlyph.descripti: Replaces the Quick Settings icons with a Control Center glyph.
en.linux.prefs.about.description: Wi‑Fi, battery and volume in one tidy top bar status icon. A GNOME Shell port of the macOS app Status Trio.
